Masters, Webb criticise FIFA over Balogun red card controversy
items.description: Two of the most powerful men in English football have joined forces to hit out at FIFA and the U-turn which allowed USA striker Folarin Balogun to play on at the World Cup last month, despite the red card which should have led to an automatic ban.

items.title: Chelsea latest: Delap and Tosin lose squad numbers amid uncertain futures
Kane plays down returning to Premier League in future
items.description: Harry Kane says "the itch isn't there as much anymore" to one day return to England from Germany and try and break the all-time scoring record in the Premier League.

items.title: Sheff Utd could face points deduction after High Court ruling
items.description: Sheffield United could incur a 12-point deduction after the company used to buy the club was placed into liquidation.

items.title: Questions remain over Vieira deal amid Senegal uncertainty
items.description: Questions remain over the appointment of Patrick Vieira as Senegal's new head coach, with the country's football federation riven by off-field issues.

items.title: Reijnders leaves Man City for Al-Qadsiah in £52m deal
items.description: Netherlands midfielder Tijjani Reijnders completes a £52m move to Saudi Arabian side Al-Qadsiah from Manchester City.

items.title: Rangers eye striker after Nedeljkovic joins from Villa
items.description: Kosta Nedeljkovic joins Rangers on a season-long loan from Aston Villa, with the Ibrox club holding a "conditional obligation" to buy the 20-year-old Serbia defender.

items.title: McInnes backs Shankland for 'big influence' at Rangers
items.description: Lawrence Shankland is "too good not to score regularly" and is sure to have a "big influence" at Rangers whether or not he starts games, insists manager Derek McInnes.
